tree.title: HY4 decoder layer 53 on PP2
tree.role: One full-indexer MoE layer invocation: chunk 12/13, 8,192 new tokens, context 90,112 → 98,304. Parent counts/time are inclusive; terminal rows partition the recorded kernels.

children.title: Sparse MLA attention sublayer
children.role: iHC input, latent projections, selector refresh, attention inputs, sparse core and output projection.

children.title: Latent query/KV projections and normalization
children.role: Produce latent Q/KV, normalize both paths, then expand the attention queries.

children.title: Refresh the sparse token selector
children.role: This layer executes the full indexer. Other layers reuse indices and do not incur this complete branch.

children.title: Indexer Q/K rotary positions
children.role: Apply indexer rotary positions before the Q/K Hadamard transforms.
children.note: One of the original unbound RoPE family’s two calls. No work numerator is divided or duplicated.

children.title: Prepare absorbed queries and the KV cache
children.role: The indexed token IDs feed sparse attention; prepare main Q/KV in their recorded execution order.

children.note: Two recorded layout-copy calls bracket the main RoPE call. Their exact buffer identities are unreviewed; grouping these calls does not assert serial stage order.

children.title: Attention Q/shared-K rotary positions
children.role: Apply the main attention rotary positions after query absorption and layout preparation.
children.note: The other original unbound RoPE call. Attribution follows the pinned source path and distinct trace interval.

children.title: Expand, gate and project the attention output
children.role: The gate GEMM also applies sigmoid and multiplication; its fused duration is counted once.

children.title: Sparse MoE feed-forward sublayer
children.role: Choose eight routed experts, run the routed and shared MLPs, then merge their outputs. This is a semantic hierarchy; parallelism is shown only in the measured timeline.

children.title: Routing and routed expert branch
children.role: Route the 8,192 tokens and evaluate eight logical experts per token.

children.title: Expert routing and dispatch
children.role: FP32 router logits, top-eight selection, NVFP4 input quantization and route indexing.

children.title: Always-active shared expert
children.role: One BF16 shared MLP; separate SwiGLU activation remains a distinct kernel.
